facts.fact: Launch Base Africa reports that the FindMe-Campost agreement signed in 2024 laid the groundwork for a country-wide Plan de Localisation Postal to standardize addressing in line with international postal standards.

Launch Base Africa reports that around 15,000 Cameroonians have generated geolocated addresses on FindMe's platform since the 2024 Campost agreement, certified through national postal partnerships for 2,000 CFA francs.

Launch Base Africa reports that CCA-Bank will require every new customer to provide a certified FindMe digital address to open an account or apply for credit, affecting more than 700,000 clients, and that 10+ local partners are integrating the system.
